findings.location: Four reviews, in order — paragraph beginning “After every reached lens”
findings.problem: The phrase “a persistent PM” is not explained, so readers cannot tell whether persistence refers to one continuing agent, durable PM records, or both; that ambiguity makes the later requirement to retain earlier classifications and routing outcomes harder to understand.
findings.suggested_direction: Define what persists when the PM is first introduced and state in plain language how that continuity preserves decisions across the sequential review lenses.
